t: This is the memorial to the sculptor Edward Onslow Ford, a Grade II listed monument on Abbey Road, close to where he once lived. Ford was a leading figure in the New Sculpture movement, admired for refined portrait busts and bronze statuettes. The monument was made by fellow sculptor Andrea Carlo Lucchesi, who also worked in the New Sculpture style, and designed by the architect Sir John William Simpson, who later served as president of the Royal Institute of British Architects.
